title: Be prepared
stale: Worked out from statements up to {date}. Upload a newer one so reminders land on the right days.
shortfallTitle: {account} may not cover this week's EMIs
shortfallBody: On {date} it had {balance}; the EMIs due in the next 7 days need {needed}. Add money before they are taken: a failed EMI costs a bank charge and usually a penalty from the lender.
emiBody: Keep the amount in the account the day before.
chargeBody_sms: Banks take this every quarter. Some drop it if you switch to app or email alerts.
chargeBody_card: Due about a year after the last one. If you hardly use the card, ask for a cheaper one or close it before then.
minBalanceBody: Keep the average balance above your account's minimum this month, or ask to switch to a zero-balance basic savings account.
